title: release.json

releaseNumber.description: Must be higher than any number production accepted before. Guards acceptance, not the active release.

contentOf.description: Set on a rollback: the release whose package this release points to.

signatures.description: Two from different Admins when the two-person rule is on.

description: Challenge = the raw 32-byte SHA-256 of the bundle archive file followed by releaseNumber as an unsigned 64-bit big-endian integer: 40 bytes (decisions #23); clientDataJSON carries it base64url-encoded. Production verifies signature, origin == APP_URL, rpIdHash, the UV flag; a signature counter is ignored only while it is 0 on both sides.
